messages:
sasha: Quick idea — instead of separate v1/v2 banners, what if the console shows one 'active version' indicator that coalesces signals (client header, console pin, token-config). We'll then sample telemetry to avoid double-counting quota/latency metrics. Thoughts?
aj: I like single ribbon UX. Biggest risk is we lose signal on mixed clients — need to preserve histograms by observed header.
maria: Agreed. For billing we can't double-charge. Can we define deterministic precedence? e.g. console pin > client header > default.
ryan: Precedence is fine. But we should also emit both raw signals for experiments (client_header, console_pin) and a computed active_version for UI/quotas.
metrics-bot: telemetry-run: found ~2.9% of requests in last 24h had both headers set (client and console pin). If we naively count both, token-billing inflates ~1.8% — we should dedupe.
sasha: Proposed sampling/coalesce approach: sample 10% of mixed-header requests and emit both signals + unique request id for tie-resolution. For rest, compute active_version deterministically and only record the computed one to billing.
aj: Can you sketch the sampling config? We can reuse existing sampling service.
sasha: Sketch:
```
sampling_policy: "mixed_headers_coalesce"
sample_rate: 0.10
emit_raw_signals_for_sampled: true
emit_active_version_always: true
```
maria: How does this affect per-tenant quota? If active_version flips we may accidentally charge against wrong quota bucket for short-lived clients.
ryan: Idea: for quota accounting, use sticky attribution per request id — whichever version is computed at ingress for that request is used end-to-end. For long sessions we keep per-session pinning.
aj: Ops question — if backend fallback switches to v1 for latency reasons, do we update active_version in-flight? That could cause confusing UX.
sasha: I propose active_version is set at request ingress and immutable for that request. Console can show 'observed: vX (computed at ingress) — backend routed: vY' for rare fallback cases.
metrics-bot: alert-check: when computed != backend_routed, 0.06% last 7d. Flagging as low but actionable.
maria: Rollout plan: 2-week canary — 5% tenant cohort (non-enterprise) with sampling enabled, full telemetry exported. Then expand to 25% with auto-rollback on billing delta >0.5%.
aj: Add a console affordance: 'Pin active version' that sets tenant override; when pinned it overrides computed. Also include small tooltip explaining how quota attribution works.
ryan: One more: ensure logs have `active_version` and `raw_version_signals` fields. Also we should add a dashboard tile showing 'double-signal rate' and 'billing delta estimate'.
sasha: I'll open an internal RFC for the sampling policy and the console mock. Will tag @frontend @billing. Thanks — I'll post followups with RFC link.
aj: :thumbsup:
maria: :100:
metrics-bot: deploy-status: sampling-proxy can handle +10k qps with current flags — no infra blocker.
ryan: If anyone wants to pair on the RFC, ping me.
